name: Arlington
notes: Arlington: the city series is the FHFA all-transactions index for Arlington-Alexandria-Reston, VA-WV (metropolitan division) (FHFA area code 11694), quarterly from 1985 Q1; the full history from the first published quarter is the long-history chart. Districts are Zillow's monthly home values (ZHVI: all homes, middle tier, smoothed, seasonally adjusted; a modelled value, not transaction prices) for 312 ZIP codes and 323 neighborhoods in the metro, shown as quarterly medians; Zillow's metro and the principal city are comparison rows. Zillow terms restrict reuse; credited, removable. Index levels are not comparable across areas: each series is rebased to 100 in the base period.
